name: THE RACCOONS
note: THE MEETING (doc 54 A5, the bait: 'Three more raccoons arrive from nowhere in particular and settle in around the first'). Three more of him, from his sheet, each a shade apart (tools/art/room23-raccoon.py). They walk in along the slope (arrive), sit around the hole's mouth, and are gone the next time Thad enters (the road exit clears T_RACCOON_MEETING). If the blanket turns the hole cold while they are here, they walk off with him.

sprite.frameNote: 0-4 the three sitting either side of the hole, turning and settling, never in step. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77).

arrive.note: In from off the frame at the right, along the slope to the hole.

exit.note: Off with the first, if the hole turns cold while they are here.
